prompt: Create an original 180 second acoustic minimalism instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: marimba, piano, muted strings. Style: phase-shifted repeating figures with small harmonic changes. Tempo approximately 98 BPM; G minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and dramatic orchestral piece featuring prominent piano and string melodies, building in intensity with a grand, emotional feel.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有戏剧性的管弦乐作品，以突出的钢琴和弦乐旋律为主，逐渐增强，营造出宏大而情感丰富的氛围。
